title: Scheduling and Monitoring Subject Matter Expert
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role Kyndryl is seeking a hands-on Scheduling and Monitoring Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead the administration, availability, operational stability, and continuous improvement of centralized enterprise IT scheduling and monitoring platforms. The role requires deep expertise in enterprise observability and workload automation tools, including Dynatrace, Opsview, and enterprise job scheduling technologies (such as IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler / TWS). The selected candidate will serve as a technical escalation point while remaining actively involved in platform configuration, upgrades, proactive alert analysis, complex troubleshooting, and 24/7 operational support. What you will do Administer, maintain, and support centralized enterprise IT scheduling and monitoring platforms, ensuring high availability and operational stability. Manage and enhance core observability and workload automation tools, specifically Dynatrace, Opsview, and enterprise job scheduling technologies (TWS). Perform ongoing platform configuration, routine maintenance, patching, and software upgrades. Support centralized scheduling functionality, batch job dependencies, and associated platform services across enterprise workloads. Review platform-level alerts and proactively investigate anomalies, bottlenecks, and identified operational issues before they impact business services. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex incidents affecting the monitoring and scheduling platforms themselves. Participate in incident resolution, root cause analysis, and escalation workflows, including operating within a two-level 24/7 on-call support model. Provide technical guidance, onboarding support, and best-practice consultation to application and infrastructure teams utilizing the centralized tools. Coordinate with external platform vendors and support providers to drive timely resolution of product defects and complex technical issues. Create, maintain, and update platform-related Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and technical documentation. Your future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your path here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience 8+ Proven hands-on experience as a Scheduling and Monitoring SME or Systems Administrator in large-scale enterprise IT environments. Deep expertise in enterprise monitoring and APM technologies, with strong hands-on administration experience in Dynatrace and Opsview . Extensive experience administering enterprise workload automation and job scheduling platforms, specifically IBM Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS) or equivalent enterprise schedulers. Strong proficiency in platform administration, including installation, configuration, patching, and major/minor software upgrades. Demonstrated ability to perform deep technical troubleshooting, alert analysis, and incident investigation for centralized tooling infrastructures. Solid understanding of complex enterprise IT, server, and multi-tier application environments to effectively support internal engineering and operations teams. Proven experience managing vendor escalations and coordinating with third-party technical support teams. Experience creating and maintaining operational runbooks, SOPs, and platform architecture documentation. Willingness and proven ability to participate in a two-level 24/7 on-call operational support rotation. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills to guide application and infrastructure teams on tool adoption and best practices. Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise Working knowledge of enterprise networking concepts and troubleshooting network-related connectivity or firewall issues impacting monitoring agents and schedulers. Familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus administration, particularly managing exclusions and resolving performance/agent conflicts on monitored hosts. Experience supporting critical production systems in regulated enterprise environments (such as banking or financial services). Relevant industry certifications in Dynatrace, IBM Workload Automation, or ITIL operational frameworks. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! description: About The Team: Come join our growing team to deliver amazing technology support experiences that fuel the vision of Dynamic Work for our employees. As a System Administrator, you will focus on delivering world-class technology support for both our employees and our workspaces, driven by the importance of the overall technology experience. This role centers on swift resolution of employee IT issues and driving proactive improvements, all while maintaining a strong commitment to a customer-first approach. Operating with an automation-first mindset , we tackle complex problems, rely on data-driven decision-making, and prioritize the overall employee experience in everything we do. As a member of our globally distributed remote and onsite IT support team, you will be the primary link for our internal customers. Your core responsibility is to provide essential Service Desk support to employees, which includes troubleshooting via Slack, Zoom, or Email, as well as managing and escalating high-priority incidents and concerns. Furthermore, you will contribute to employee productivity by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and guiding users in the effective use of technology. You will have a security-first mindset and let policies guide how you work with our customers. You will be a strong advocate for our employees, learning and understanding their technology challenges and championing change with modern AI and automation solutions that make it easier to get our best work done. The successful System Administrator is expected to possess a strong grasp and proven capability in resolving issues across various technologies. This includes proficiency with hardware (Apple/Windows), mobile devices, networks, and operating systems, as well as common internet and SaaS applications (browsers, Slack, Google Workspace, Office, Okta) and AI agent workflows. The ideal candidate will also have great attention to detail and will be comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment. Our goal is to make sure that our customers have an amazing technology experience and that they have everything they need to be successful. What you’ll do: Deliver an exceptional customer support experience to all Rubrik employees and contractors. This position necessitates a 24/7 commitment, requiring flexibility to work across various shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. Strive to achieve first-contact resolution for all employee support interactions whenever feasible. Diligently and proactively manage competing priorities within a high-velocity environment. Connect with employees via Slack and Zoom to provide real-time troubleshooting support, along with providing a superior transfer of support experience as needed. Manage end-to-end ticket lifecycles across Incident, Change, and Problem Management using JIRA. Drive ticket hygiene across the queue, build operational dashboards, and actively track and chase team KPIs and SLAs. Mentor junior team members on complex ticket resolutions, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT best practices. Apply an automation-first approach to identify process gaps, using critical thinking to streamline workflows and build custom AI agents (using tools like Claude Cowork/Code) for continuous process improvement. Support key Employee Lifecycle processes (onboarding and offboarding) and manage provisioning and deprovisioning of applications via Okta and Okta Workflows. Strong demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate policies and technical processes with customers of all levels. Actively contribute to team knowledge by documenting newly found solutions for common issues and proactively sharing information with the team. Handle escalations from Level 1 Service Desk agents. Support complex problem-solving related to Slack, Google Workspace, MS O365, MDM tools (Jamf & Intune), and JIRA reporting. Perform regular audits on assets, onboarding, and offboarding data for accuracy and hygiene. Track and manage shift handovers. Preferred qualifications: 5+ years supporting internal or external customers in a Global IT Service Desk environment. 5+ years experience supporting Mac and Windows devices. 5+ years managing user and role-based access in a predominantly SaaS-based environment. Hands-on experience administering Okta, building Okta Workflows, and managing macOS environments via Jamf. Hands-on experience with Claude (Cowork/Code) with proven ability to build AI agents for IT process automation and improvement. Strong ITIL foundation with proven experience handling Incident, Change, and Problem Management, alongside SLA/KPI tracking and dashboard creation. An automation-first outlook paired with strong critical thinking skills to identify operational gaps and eliminate manual tasks. Familiarity with or demonstrated experience in supporting video conferencing systems is desired. Proficiency in troubleshooting Windows and Mac platforms, leveraging expertise in Jamf and/or Intune. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash or Python for automation tasks related to Jamf is highly desirable (not mandatory, but good to have). Good working knowledge of Google Workspace, Slack, JIRA, MS O365, and MDM tools. Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. Experience supporting high-priority escalations and high-pressure situations. Strong ability to prioritize multiple tasks to ensure support for customers and the team. Additional skills or certifications a plus: Okta & Okta Workflows Claude (Code/Cowork) & AI Agent Development Google Workspace Jamf Intune Atlassian Suite (JIRA/Confluence) Slack O365 Zoom Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. This is a controls role as much as a technical one: the administrator builds least-privilege roles that still let Finance, Accounting, Procurement and Human Resources do their jobs, and remediates conflicting access before an auditor or an incident finds it. Build roles to least privilege from business-process requirements rather than copying delivered roles, and document the business justification for every custom role. Administer data security, including data access sets, business unit and ledger-level security and security profiles, and maintain OTBI and BI Publisher reporting security. Maintain a controlled role catalog with naming standards, ownership and a documented change trail, and continually rationalize duplicate, unused, over-privileged and orphaned roles. Administer the Oracle user and role-assignment lifecycle, including provisioning, modification, transfer and timely termination, strictly in accordance with approved request and approval workflow and in coordination with the IAM team. Plan, execute and document periodic user access reviews and recertification campaigns with business owners, including follow-through on revocations. Reconcile Oracle access against HR records to detect accounts for terminated, transferred or dormant users. Govern service, integration and interface accounts, and administer privileged and emergency (break-glass) access with pre-approval, time limits, monitoring and after-the-fact review. Own the Oracle segregation of duties ruleset and perform conflict analysis on both current access and proposed changes before they are implemented. Administer access control and risk tooling (Oracle Risk Management Cloud / Advanced Access Controls or equivalent), remediate conflicts through role redesign, and document mitigating controls where conflicts cannot be eliminated. Restrict sensitive access, including bank account, vendor master, payment, journal entry, HR and payroll and security administration capabilities, to the minimum necessary population. Monitor for and investigate inappropriate or anomalous access and activity, escalating to Information Security per the incident response process. Produce access, change and privileged-activity evidence for internal and external audit and SOX or equivalent IT general control testing, and serve as the primary respondent for Oracle access questions during audits. Track Oracle access audit findings and control deficiencies through remediation to validated closure. Maintain tenant-level security settings, govern API and integration access, and ensure sensitive data is masked and access restricted in non-production environments. Train requesters, approvers and reviewers so access requests arrive correct and access reviews are performed meaningfully rather than rubber-stamped. Document and maintain security design, provisioning procedures and control narratives sufficient for an auditor or successor to follow. Maintain a strong working knowledge of Oracle Cloud security capabilities, access governance practices and audit expectations, and communicate relevant improvements to team members and leadership. In-depth knowledge of the Oracle Cloud security model, including privileges, duty roles, job roles, aggregate privileges, data security policies and security profiles. Working knowledge of IT general controls, access governance and audit evidence expectations in a financial systems environment. Reporting and query skills sufficient to extract and analyze access data using OTBI, BI Publisher and SQL. Experience with ITIL-aligned change and incident management and with IT service-management platforms; ServiceNow is preferred. Excellent written and verbal business-English communication skills, with the ability to translate between auditor, accounting and Oracle security language across cultures and time zones. Ability to say no to an access request that creates a conflict or exceeds least privilege, and explain the reasoning in business terms. Ability to hold the line on documentation and approval requirements under time pressure, including during close and audit deadlines. Strong problem-solving and data-analysis skills, including analyzing large access data sets and reaching sound conclusions about risk. title: IT Support Engineer
description: Sikich is hiring an IT Support Engineer - NOC Analyst to join our Managed Services team. This is an infrastructure and server-side NOC role focused on monitoring, triaging, and supporting client server, network, cloud, and backup environments across multiple clients. The engineer will operate within defined NOC procedures, respond to infrastructure alerts, execute standard troubleshooting for common NOC events such as server, internet, and power outages, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers or US-based on-call consultants when required. Strong ownership, documentation discipline, and clean escalation are core expectations for this role. About the firm Sikich is a global company specializing in Accounting, Advisory, and Technical professional services. With employees across the globe, Sikich ranks as one of the largest professional services companies in the United States. Our comprehensive skillsets, obtained over decades of experience as entrepreneurs, business owners and industry innovators, allow us to provide insights and transformative strategies to help strengthen every dimension of our clients businesses. What will you do in this role? Monitor client infrastructure environments including servers, networks, backups, cloud resources, and endpoint management platforms across multiple clients. Investigate and triage infrastructure alerts related to servers, networking, internet connectivity, power, backups, and availability of business-critical systems. Support Windows Server environments through service and role health checks, event log review, resource utilization checks, disk space monitoring, and basic server-side troubleshooting. Perform Active Directory operations tasks including account status checks, group membership validation, account lockout investigation, and escalation of directory-related issues. Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, VPN, connectivity, and basic network incidents using standardized diagnostic steps. Troubleshoot basic switching, VLAN, wireless, and firewall connectivity issues using standardized diagnostic steps, and escalate complex network faults to senior engineers or the client's network provider. Perform basic health checks on virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V, including VM state, host health, and resource utilization. Monitor backup jobs, investigate backup failures, and escalate restore-related concerns based on documented backup procedures. Monitor patch compliance across servers and endpoints, deploy operating system and third-party updates through RMM tooling, triage patch failures, and coordinate reboots and maintenance windows per documented procedures. Execute NOC runbooks and SOPs for common infrastructure events and escalate cleanly when issues fall outside defined procedures. Coordinate with senior engineers and US-based on-call consultants for complex incidents by providing clear findings, evidence, and troubleshooting steps already performed. Maintain accurate ticket documentation including alert details, business impact, investigation steps, resolution notes, and escalation trail. Provide clear and timely updates to internal teams and clients during incident investigation and resolution. Contribute to knowledge sharing, SOP updates, and continuous improvement of NOC procedures and runbooks. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and SLAs while delivering infrastructure support. Participate in after-hours on-call rotation as required to support client NOC needs outside regular business hours. What do you need to succeed in this role? 2-4 years of experience in Infrastructure Support, NOC Operations, Managed Services, Server Support, or a closely related IT operations role. Hands-on exposure to Windows Server environments and basic server-side troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy basics. Experience with monitoring platforms and infrastructure alert response. Exposure to patch management and operating system / third-party update deployment through RMM or patch management tooling. Solid understanding of network fundamentals including IP addressing, routing basics, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting. Exposure to backup monitoring, failed backup triage, and restore concepts. Basic understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Azure fundamentals, particularly where tied to infrastructure support. Ability to follow SOPs and runbooks and document troubleshooting clearly in a ticketing system. Strong ownership, communication, and escalation discipline in a client-facing Managed Services environment. Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or multi-client support environment. Hands-on experience with tools such as ConnectWise Manage, ConnectWise Automate/LabTech, LogicMonitor, Datto, or similar PSA / RMM / monitoring / backup platforms. Certifications from Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Windows Server), VMware (VCP), Cisco, Fortinet, or ITIL Foundation. Exposure to firewall, switch, access point, and basic server hardware troubleshooting. Experience supporting after-hours or rotational NOC coverage in an MSP delivery model. You are accountable for the numbers being right, not only for the pipelines running. Build and maintain the Azure Data Factory pipelines serving Trade Promotion Management and Consumer Goods Cloud, including validation, error handling and monitoring. Operate the integrations that move data between Salesforce, SAP and the planning systems, including the master data and actuals feeds. Proactively propose and implement improvements to reporting, reconciliation and data quality, rather than reporting the same issues repeatedly. Interpret procedures where a situation requires it, and adjust systems and processes to improve the reliability of the numbers. Communicate with commercial and finance colleagues outside Commercial Applications, and with vendors in coordination with the IT Lead. Provide guidance and training to more junior colleagues, and lead the team on metric definitions and reconciliation practice. Expected contributions Pipelines and feeds reaching the platform are complete, on time and reconciled, with the monitoring to prove it. The numbers are right, not only the reports running: actuals reconciled against source systems. Metric definitions owned and consistent across markets (the semantic layer automated analysis depends on). Every AI-generated figure that reaches a financial report is reviewed; this work does not move to sampling. Validation rules and reconciliation checks catch errors before users do. University degree or equivalent training in the discipline of work, with a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience. Broad theoretical and practical knowledge of data engineering and of the related reporting, integration and commercial finance disciplines. Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory, including parameterised pipelines, error handling and monitoring. Practical experience of integration patterns between a CRM platform and an ERP. Strong SQL, and hands-on experience building reports and dashboards over commercial data. Experience with Salesforce reporting or CRM Analytics; Salesforce Administrator certification preferred. Experience reconciling financial or sales actuals between systems. Mobile SIM/data card, subject to company policy. Hybrid working model.
